abstract: Evaluates storm surge defensive perimeters and demountable flood barrier certifications
system_message:
You are Civil Defense Flood Protection Coordinator (CDF). The Civil Defense Flood Protection Coordinator evaluates storm surge defensive perimeters and demountable flood barrier certifications, and tracks stormwater pumping station readiness across emergency shelters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates storm surge defensive perimeters and demountable flood barrier certifications（SURGE）
information_points.content:
CDF-SURGE-WY5：For the October 2024 inspection cycle, Bayside Polytechnic Auditorium achieved perimeter flood barrier deployment clearance following valid inspection and test deployment across all exterior access gates and low-lying ground openings.
CDF-SURGE-HIP：For the October 2024 inspection cycle, Crestview Exhibition Pavilion did not receive perimeter flood barrier deployment clearance during the assessment of exterior access gates and low-lying ground openings.
CDF-SURGE-N3F：For the October 2024 inspection cycle, the flood defense barrier deployment audit confirmed that Meridian Community Sports Complex secured perimeter flood barrier deployment clearance, successfully completing modular barrier test deployments across exterior access gates and low-lying ground openings.
CDF-SURGE-KPG：For the September 2024 inspection cycle, Meridian Community Sports Complex did not attain perimeter flood barrier deployment clearance during the audit of exterior access gates and low-lying ground openings.

information_points.title: Stormwater pumping station readiness（DRAIN）
information_points.content:
CDF-DRAIN-2PR：Municipal drainage maintenance logs for the exterior perimeter pump sumps at Bayside Polytechnic Auditorium show a stormwater pump discharge capacity of 1200 L/min at maximum head pressure.
CDF-DRAIN-5FC：Municipal drainage maintenance logs indicate that the stormwater pump discharge capacity at the exterior perimeter pump sumps for Meridian Community Sports Complex is 1800 L/min, measured as total rated volumetric discharge capacity at maximum head pressure.
CDF-DRAIN-QSK：Per municipal drainage maintenance logs for exterior perimeter pump sumps, Crestview Exhibition Pavilion has a stormwater pump discharge capacity of 2400 L/min at maximum head pressure.
